section_emphasis.business_model: SaaS overlay: In addition to the base brief, you MUST present the segment-revenue split with explicit growth and attach-rate framing (segment_revenue_yoy and product-attach metrics where disclosed). Cite `nrr_dollar_based`, `rule_of_40_score`, and `cRPO` by name when describing unit economics.
section_emphasis.risk_analysis: SaaS overlay: Add a 'Seat rationalization' downside sub-section. Cite `rule_of_40_score` and `nrr_dollar_based`. Frame the macro-cycle risk: customer headcount reductions translate to seat-based ARR compression; quantify the sensitivity to a 10% seat cut where data permits.
section_emphasis.recent_developments: SaaS overlay: Include a dated catalyst calendar in addition to the base 30-day developments. Catalyst calendar items: next earnings print date, next user conference, dated product/monetization milestones disclosed by the company. Each calendar row carries a citation.
